_comment: Optional webhook configuration for ops-dashboard notifications. Copy to ~/ops-dashboard/config.json and fill in any subset. Leave blank to disable that channel.
_docs: Slack/Discord use incoming webhook URLs. See https://api.slack.com/messaging/webhooks for setup. Telegram is not a notification target: use the Channels page (it sends only run results to paired chats).
_events: Currently fires on url_failed (status != 200) and url_recovered (back to 200). More events coming (brain_ask, todo_done, agent_wake).
_env_override: Any of these can also be set as environment variables (preferred for secrets — don't commit config.json with real values).
